card.name: Leading digit of a half-step dose
card.fires_on: The digit just before a decimal point or fraction in dose tables, where the number is likely to end in .5 or ½. Also fires on a decimal point or the word inch before 'half' style amounts.

modes.label: Digit before .5 in dose tables
modes.description: A single digit at the start of a decimal volume or amount in a titration or weight-band table, where a half value (.5) comes next.

modes.label: Fraction or decimal in other text
modes.description: A decimal point or unit word that is followed by a fractional amount, in adverse-event rates or measurements.
modes.example: four patients (0<<.>>3%) experienced a Grade 4 oc

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing half, ½ or a half-unit amount next.
card.plain: It spots a number in a dose table that is about to be followed by a half, like 7.5 or 1½.
